d: A hulking humanoid creature with pale mint-green skin and a massive, muscular build. The face is obscured by a high, architectural stone cowl featuring a single, large, glowing iris in the center. The attire consists of heavy, slate-grey and pale-blue stone armor plating, including oversized pauldrons, a wide belt with a circular floral emblem, and a layered stone skirt over dark fabric. The creature wields two large, spiked maces attached by heavy iron chains to its gauntlets. BODY COLOR: pale mint-green LEGS: plantigrade, obscured by stone armor and fabric.
